-- Copyright (c) 2019 Digital Asset (Switzerland) GmbH and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
--
-- This file contains unit tests aka scripts that can be executed on the
-- ledger without having to run an external process to submit the transactions.

module Scripts where

import Daml.Script

import Main

setup = script do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  sally <- allocateParty "Sally"
  rebecca <- allocateParty "Rebecca"

  -- The issuer ‘mints’ these tokens on the blockchain into their own wallet.
  issuerWalletId <- submit issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with
      issuer = issuer
      owner = issuer
      tokens = 1000
      maxTokens = 1000

  -- The issuer now has a wallet which shows 1,000 of their blockchain-based shares or tokens.
  Some issuerWallet <- queryContractId issuer issuerWalletId
  assert(issuerWallet.owner == issuer && issuerWallet.tokens == 1000)

  -- The issuer sends one token to another wallet owned by Sally.

  -- 1. Authorize Sally to accept the token prior to the blockchain ‘clearing’
  -- or confirming the transaction.
  sallyWalletId <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd issuerWalletId AuthorizeInvestor with
      investor = sally
      maxTokens' = 1

  sallyTokenRequestId <- submit sally do
    exerciseCmd sallyWalletId RequestTokens with requestedQuantity = 1

  (issuerWalletId, sallysWalletId) <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd issuerWalletId AcceptTokenRequest with requestId = sallyTokenRequestId

  -- Sally’s wallet that received the token from the issuer now holds one token.
  Some sallyWallet <- queryContractId sally sallysWalletId
  assert(sallyWallet.tokens == 1)

  -- The recipient is now in sole custody of one token.
  Some issuerWallet <- queryContractId issuer issuerWalletId
  assert(issuerWallet.tokens == 999)

  -- 2. Can the issuer revoke the token from Sally? Upon revocation will the
  -- token simply be subtracted from the outstanding supply or will the token
  -- be transferred from Sally’s wallet back to the issuers wallet?
  (sallyWalletId, issuerWalletId) <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd sallysWalletId TransferTokens with
      quantity = 1
      toWalletId = issuerWalletId

  -- 3. Can the issuer createCmd a ‘rule’ in the smart contract limiting how many
  -- tokens from the outstanding supply Sally may hold?
  submitMustFail issuer do
    exerciseCmd issuerWalletId TransferTokens with
      quantity = 2
      toWalletId = sallyWalletId

  -- 4. The issuer also wishes to send a token to Rebecca. The issuer would like
  -- for Rebecca to not be able to send the token to Sally and vice versa. Is
  -- this possible to enforce?
  rebeccaAuthId <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd issuerWalletId AuthorizeInvestor with
      investor = rebecca
      maxTokens' = 20

  (issuerWalletId, rebeccasWalletId) <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd issuerWalletId TransferTokens with
        quantity = 10
        toWalletId = rebeccaAuthId

  submitMustFail rebecca do
    exerciseCmd rebeccasWalletId TransferTokens with
        quantity = 1
        toWalletId = sallyWalletId

module Scripts where

import Daml.Script
import Main
getContract : (Template t) => Party -> ContractId t -> Script t
getContract party contractId = do
  result <- queryContractId party contractId
  case result of
    Some contract -> pure contract
    None -> error "Expected active visible contract"


authorizationAndWalletBounds : Script ()
authorizationAndWalletBounds = script do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  root <- submit issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = issuer; issuer; tokens = 0; maxTokens = 0
  aliceWallet <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd root AuthorizeInvestor with investor = alice; maxTokens' = 10
  aliceState <- getContract issuer aliceWallet
  assert (aliceState.owner == alice)
  assert (aliceState.issuer == issuer)
  assert (aliceState.tokens == 0)
  assert (aliceState.maxTokens == 10)
  _ <- getContract issuer root
  _ <- getContract alice aliceWallet
  do
    visible <- queryContractId bob aliceWallet
    assert (visible == None)
  do
    visible <- queryContractId alice root
    assert (visible == None)
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd aliceWallet AuthorizeInvestor with investor = bob; maxTokens' = 5
  submitMustFail issuer do
    exerciseCmd root AuthorizeInvestor with investor = bob; maxTokens' = -1
  submitMustFail issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = bob; issuer; tokens = -1; maxTokens = 10
  submitMustFail issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = bob; issuer; tokens = 11; maxTokens = 10
  submitMustFail issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = bob; issuer; tokens = 0; maxTokens = -1
  submitMustFail bob do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = bob; issuer; tokens = 1; maxTokens = 10
  boundary <- submit issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = bob; issuer; tokens = 10; maxTokens = 10
  boundaryState <- getContract bob boundary
  assert (boundaryState.tokens == 10)

transferUpdatesBothWallets : Script ()
transferUpdatesBothWallets = script do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  source <- submit issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = alice; issuer; tokens = 8; maxTokens = 12
  destination <- submit issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = bob; issuer; tokens = 2; maxTokens = 10
  (newSource, newDestination) <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd source TransferTokens with quantity = 3; toWalletId = destination
  sourceState <- getContract issuer newSource
  destinationState <- getContract issuer newDestination
  assert (sourceState.owner == alice)
  assert (sourceState.issuer == issuer)
  assert (sourceState.tokens == 5)
  assert (sourceState.maxTokens == 12)
  assert (destinationState.owner == bob)
  assert (destinationState.issuer == issuer)
  assert (destinationState.tokens == 5)
  assert (destinationState.maxTokens == 10)
  do
    visible <- queryContractId issuer source
    assert (visible == None)
  do
    visible <- queryContractId issuer destination
    assert (visible == None)
  _ <- getContract alice newSource
  _ <- getContract bob newDestination
  do
    visible <- queryContractId bob newSource
    assert (visible == None)
  do
    visible <- queryContractId alice newDestination
    assert (visible == None)
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd newSource TransferTokens with quantity = 1; toWalletId = newDestination
  (emptySource, fullDestination) <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd newSource TransferTokens with quantity = 5; toWalletId = newDestination
  emptyState <- getContract issuer emptySource
  fullState <- getContract issuer fullDestination
  assert (emptyState.tokens == 0)
  assert (fullState.tokens == 10)

transferRejectsInvalidBalances : Script ()
transferRejectsInvalidBalances = script do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  source <- submit issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = alice; issuer; tokens = 5; maxTokens = 10
  destination <- submit issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = bob; issuer; tokens = 8; maxTokens = 10
  submitMustFail issuer do
    exerciseCmd source TransferTokens with quantity = 6; toWalletId = destination
  submitMustFail issuer do

  submitMustFail issuer do

  unchangedSource <- getContract issuer source
  unchangedDestination <- getContract issuer destination
  assert (unchangedSource.tokens == 5)
  assert (unchangedDestination.tokens == 8)
  (afterSource, afterDestination) <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd source TransferTokens with quantity = 2; toWalletId = destination
  finalSource <- getContract issuer afterSource
  finalDestination <- getContract issuer afterDestination
  assert (finalSource.tokens == 3)
  assert (finalDestination.tokens == 10)

requestAndAcceptance : Script ()
requestAndAcceptance = script do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  source <- submit issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = alice; issuer; tokens = 9; maxTokens = 10
  destination <- submit issuer do

  request <- submit bob do

  originalDestination <- getContract issuer destination
  assert (originalDestination.tokens == 1)
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd source AcceptTokenRequest with requestId = request
  (newSource, newDestination) <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd source AcceptTokenRequest with requestId = request
  sourceState <- getContract issuer newSource
  destinationState <- getContract issuer newDestination
  assert (sourceState.tokens == 5)
  assert (destinationState.tokens == 5)
  assert (destinationState.owner == bob)
  _ <- getContract issuer request
  do
    visible <- queryContractId issuer destination
    assert (visible == None)
  submitMustFail issuer do
    exerciseCmd newSource AcceptTokenRequest with requestId = request

requestsRespectLimits : Script ()
requestsRespectLimits = script do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  source <- submit issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = alice; issuer; tokens = 3; maxTokens = 10
  destination <- submit issuer do
    createCmd Wallet with owner = bob; issuer; tokens = 2; maxTokens = 5
  tooLarge <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd destination RequestTokens with requestedQuantity = 4
  submitMustFail issuer do
    exerciseCmd source AcceptTokenRequest with requestId = tooLarge
  tooMuch <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd destination RequestTokens with requestedQuantity = 6
  submitMustFail issuer do
    exerciseCmd source AcceptTokenRequest with requestId = tooMuch
  unchangedSource <- getContract issuer source
  unchangedDestination <- getContract issuer destination
  assert (unchangedSource.tokens == 3)
  assert (unchangedDestination.tokens == 2)
  exact <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd destination RequestTokens with requestedQuantity = 3
  (emptySource, fullDestination) <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd source AcceptTokenRequest with requestId = exact
  sourceState <- getContract issuer emptySource
  destinationState <- getContract issuer fullDestination
  assert (sourceState.tokens == 0)
  assert (destinationState.tokens == 5)

transferEdgeCases : Script ()
transferEdgeCases = script do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  source <- submit issuer do

  destination <- submit issuer do

  submitMustFail issuer do
    exerciseCmd source TransferTokens with quantity = 1; toWalletId = source
  (zeroSource, zeroDestination) <- submit issuer do
    exerciseCmd source TransferTokens with quantity = 0; toWalletId = destination
  sourceState <- getContract issuer zeroSource
  destinationState <- getContract issuer zeroDestination
  assert (sourceState.tokens == 3)
  assert (destinationState.tokens == 4)
  do

  do

    assert (visible == None)
  (reverseSource, reverseDestination) <- submit issuer do

  reverseSourceState <- getContract issuer reverseSource
  reverseDestinationState <- getContract issuer reverseDestination
  assert (reverseSourceState.tokens == 5)
  assert (reverseDestinationState.tokens == 2)

requestAuthorityAndVisibility : Script ()
requestAuthorityAndVisibility = script do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"

  destination <- submit issuer do

  submitMustFail issuer do

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd destination RequestTokens with requestedQuantity = 1
  submitMustFail issuer do
    createCmd TokenRequest with issuer; owner = bob; walletId = destination; quantity = 1
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd source TransferTokens with quantity = 1; toWalletId = destination
  request <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd destination RequestTokens with requestedQuantity = 2
  requestState <- getContract bob request
  assert (requestState.quantity == 2)
  do

    assert (visible == None)
  _ <- getContract issuer source
  _ <- getContract issuer destination
  pure ()
